# Fastest 10 m on a skateboard by a cat
![Fastest 10 m on a skateboard by a cat](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)
**Share**

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) [ Apply Now ](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/account/application/begin/15-112073) Who
    Bao Zi What
     12.85 second(s)  Where
     China (Wenzhou)  When
     04 April 2024 
The fastest 10 m on a skateboard by a cat is 12.85 seconds and was achieved by Bao Zi (China) in Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China, on 4 April 2024.
The owner Li Jiangtao (China) is hoping to let more people acknowledge about the sport project "Cat plays skateboard". The cat playing skateboard video is very popular on social media.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
